sloka: ये हन्यन्ते रणे तत्र राक्षसाः कपिकुञ्जरैः।हता हतास्तु क्षिप्यन्ते सर्व एव तु सागरे ।। ६.७४.७६ ।।
transliteration: ye hanyante raṇe tatra rākṣasāḥ kapikuñjaraiḥ।hatā hatāstu kṣipyante sarva eva tu sāgare ।। 6.74.76 ।।

translations.english: Then that monkey of towering might, the son of the bearer of scents, carried the mountain of healing herbs swiftly back to Himavat itself, and came again to Rama.
